during-the-fremennik-isles.npc: Can't talk now, I'm on duty.

standard-dialogue-in-the-town.player: Good day! How are you doing?

standard-dialogue-in-the-town.npc: Pretty good. It's nice to have a day off from troll- killing duty.
Of course. It's all part of growing up around here. You get used to it.

standard-dialogue-in-the-town-while-wear.npc: Good day, jester! Got any new jokes?

standard-dialogue-in-the-town-while-wear.player: No. I only use old, recycled jokes. It's better for the environment.

standard-dialogue-on-the-walls.npc: Are you here to help with the trolls?

standard-dialogue-on-the-walls.player: I'm afraid not, I have other things to do.

standard-dialogue-on-the-walls.npc: Well, watch yourself. Those rocks that the trolls throw can take your arm off.

standard-dialogue-on-the-walls-while-wea.npc: Hey jester, this area is not a suitable place for civilians to wander about in. Trolls everywhere.

standard-dialogue-on-the-walls-while-wea.player: Right you are. I'll be careful.

standard-dialogue-outside-of-the-town.npc: I hope you're not heading north. There are lots of trolls, very dangerous.

standard-dialogue-outside-of-the-town.player: Thanks for the warning. I'll keep my eyes peeled.

standard-dialogue-outside-of-the-town-wh.npc: Good day, jester! Got any new jokes?

standard-dialogue-outside-of-the-town-wh.player: No. I only use old, recycled jokes. It's better for the environment.
